home.title: Praxys — Science-grounded training decisions for runners
home.description: Praxys interprets Garmin, Strava, COROS, Stryd, and Oura data into daily training decisions, adaptive plans, race forecasts, and cited sport-science explanations.
home.heading: Turn training data into a decision.
home.lead: Praxys is a science-grounded endurance training system for self-coached runners. It combines your training and recovery data, explains what it means, and recommends the next action.
summaryPoints: Daily decisions · go, modify, or rest, with the reasoning visible.
Training direction · zones, thresholds, plans, and race forecasts adapt to your data.
Science with boundaries · cited methods, explicit limitations, and opt-in Labs research.

product.title: Praxys product capabilities — Training decisions, plans, Labs, and forecasts
product.description: See how Praxys turns Garmin, Strava, COROS, Stryd, and Oura data into daily readiness decisions, training diagnosis, plans, race forecasts, and opt-in research.
product.heading: A training system that takes a position.
product.lead: Praxys is built for runners who want an answer, not another dashboard. It interprets fragmented training data into a clear recommendation, then shows the evidence and published methodology behind it.

sections.heading: Daily training decisions
sections.body: Praxys combines recent load, sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, and upcoming training into a go, modify, or rest signal. The recommendation is deterministic when AI services are unavailable.

sections.heading: Training diagnosis
sections.body: Weekly analysis reviews zone distribution, threshold trends, fitness-fatigue balance, and workout execution. Intensity analysis uses activity splits rather than diluted whole-activity average power.

sections.heading: Managed training plans
sections.body: Praxys plan management is provider-independent: it can manage its own or explicitly adopted workouts in a rolling 14-day window. Delivery currently supports Garmin and Stryd, remains opt-in and auditable, and is designed not to edit or delete manual or other-coach workouts.

sections.heading: Race forecasts and goals
sections.body: Race predictions quantify the gap between current evidence and a target. Praxys supports road and trail distances from 5K through 100 miles and distinguishes estimates from stronger evidence.

sections.heading: Praxys Labs
sections.body: Labs contains voluntary, consented experiments that inspect an athlete's own history. The first experiment explores historical heart-rate response across modeled heat and humidity at comparable recorded Stryd power; it is not a forecast, heat-safety assessment, or training prescription.

sections.heading: Published science, visible in context
sections.body: Metrics, formulas, and constants carry source citations. Athletes can inspect how a number was calculated and choose among supported training theories instead of treating one opaque model as universal truth.

product.dataBody: Praxys currently connects to Garmin and COROS for activities, fitness, and recovery signals; Strava for activities; Stryd for running power; and Oura for recovery. Plan management is provider-independent, with delivery currently supported to Garmin and Stryd. Athletes can train by power, heart rate, or pace; running power is supported deeply but is not required.
product.boundaryHeading: What the AI coach does not do
boundaries: It does not replace medical care or present research experiments as safety advice.
It does not invent evidence when data is missing or bypass deterministic plan validation.
It does not publish athlete data, credentials, screenshots, or private context to public trackers.

faq.title: Praxys FAQ — Training decisions, connected platforms, AI, plans, and privacy
faq.description: Direct answers about how Praxys interprets training data, supported Garmin, Strava, COROS, Stryd, and Oura connections, controlled AI, managed plans, and data use.
faq.heading: Questions runners ask before trusting a training system.
faq.lead: Short answers first. Praxys is specific about what it can infer, what remains uncertain, and where athlete consent sets the boundary.

questions.question: What does Praxys do that my watch or training app does not?
questions.answer: Praxys does more than display data. It combines training and recovery information into a clear recommendation: train as planned, modify the session, or recover. It then shows the trends, evidence, and methodology behind that decision.

questions.question: Which platforms can I connect?
questions.answer: Praxys currently connects with Garmin, Strava, COROS, Stryd, and Oura to bring together activity and recovery data. Managed workouts can currently be delivered to Garmin and Stryd.

questions.question: How does Praxys combine sport science, personalization, and AI?
questions.answer: Praxys starts with your training data and published sport science, using deterministic calculations and validation rules to establish a reliable foundation. AI is then used where it is strongest: interpreting patterns, explaining trade-offs, exploring research, and adapting plans to your situation. Sources, explicit limitations, plan validation, and rule-based fallbacks keep the result traceable and controlled rather than asking you to trust a black box.

questions.question: How do managed training plans work?
questions.answer: Praxys manages its own or explicitly adopted workouts in a rolling 14-day window, independently of the delivery provider. Plans can respond to your current training and recovery state. You choose Garmin or Stryd for delivery and can pause, resume, resolve conflicts, or leave managed mode.

questions.question: How does Praxys use my training data?
questions.answer: Your data is used to provide your training analysis, recommendations, and plans. Praxys does not sell athlete data or use it for advertising. Research features such as Praxys Labs require separate, explicit consent. The Privacy Policy explains processing, retention, and security details.

home.title: Praxys — 为跑者提供有科学依据的训练决策
home.description: Praxys 将 Garmin、Strava、COROS、Stryd 与 Oura 数据转化为每日训练决策、动态计划、比赛预测和带文献来源的运动科学解释。
home.heading: 把训练数据，变成明确决策。
home.lead: Praxys 是为自主训练跑者打造的科学训练系统。它整合训练与恢复数据，解释这些数据意味着什么，并给出下一步行动建议。
summaryPoints: 每日决策 · 给出正常训练、调整或休息的信号，并展示判断依据。
训练方向 · 区间、阈值、计划与比赛预测会随数据持续调整。
科学边界 · 方法有来源、限制明确，Labs 研究仅在自愿参与后进行。

product.title: Praxys 产品能力 — 训练决策、计划、Labs 与比赛预测
product.description: 了解 Praxys 如何把 Garmin、Strava、COROS、Stryd 与 Oura 数据转化为每日状态判断、训练诊断、计划、比赛预测和自愿研究。
product.heading: 一个会明确给出判断的训练系统。
product.lead: Praxys 面向需要答案、而不是更多仪表盘的跑者。它把分散的训练数据解释成清晰建议，并展示建议背后的证据与已发表方法。

sections.heading: 每日训练决策
sections.body: Praxys 综合近期负荷、睡眠、HRV、静息心率与接下来的训练，给出正常训练、调整或休息的信号。即使 AI 服务不可用，确定性规则仍会提供建议。

sections.heading: 训练诊断
sections.body: 每周分析训练区间分布、阈值趋势、体能与疲劳平衡以及训练执行情况。强度分析使用分段数据，而不是被热身、放松和恢复段稀释的整次活动平均功率。

sections.heading: 托管训练计划
sections.body: Praxys 的计划管理不依赖特定交付平台，可以在未来 14 天的滚动窗口内管理自己生成或由跑者明确接管的训练。目前支持交付到 Garmin 和 Stryd；交付需要主动开启并保留审计记录，不会编辑或删除手动创建或其他教练安排的训练。

sections.heading: 比赛预测与目标
sections.body: 比赛预测会量化当前证据与目标之间的差距。Praxys 支持从 5 公里到 100 英里的公路与越野距离，并明确区分估算与证据更强的结论。

sections.heading: Praxys Labs
sections.body: Labs 提供需要明确同意的自愿实验，用于检查跑者自己的历史数据。首个实验探索在相近 Stryd 记录功率下，历史心率与模型化温湿度条件的关系；它不是预测、热安全评估或训练处方。

sections.heading: 在上下文中展示科学依据
sections.body: 指标、公式与常数都带有来源。跑者可以查看数值如何计算，也可以选择受支持的训练理论，而不是被迫相信一个不透明模型适用于所有人。

product.dataBody: Praxys 当前可连接 Garmin 与 COROS 的活动、体能和恢复信号，Strava 的活动数据，Stryd 的跑步功率，以及 Oura 的恢复数据。计划管理不依赖特定平台，目前支持交付到 Garmin 和 Stryd。跑者可以按功率、心率或配速训练；系统深入支持跑步功率，但不要求必须使用。
boundaries: 不会替代医疗服务，也不会把研究实验包装成安全建议。
不会在数据缺失时编造证据，也不会绕过确定性的计划校验。
不会把跑者数据、凭据、截图或私密背景发布到公开追踪系统。

faq.title: Praxys 常见问题 — 训练决策、平台连接、AI、计划与隐私
faq.description: 直接了解 Praxys 如何解释训练数据、支持的 Garmin、Strava、COROS、Stryd 与 Oura 连接、受控 AI、托管计划和数据使用方式。
faq.heading: 在信任一个训练系统之前，跑者常问的问题。
faq.lead: 先给直接答案。Praxys 会明确说明能够推断什么、哪些地方仍有不确定性，以及跑者的同意如何划定边界。

questions.question: Praxys 与手表或普通训练应用有什么不同？
questions.answer: Praxys 不只是展示数据。它会整合训练与恢复信息，给出按计划训练、调整训练或恢复的明确建议，并展示支撑判断的趋势、证据和方法。

questions.question: 可以连接哪些平台？
questions.answer: Praxys 目前可连接 Garmin、Strava、COROS、Stryd 和 Oura，汇集活动与恢复数据。托管训练目前可交付到 Garmin 和 Stryd。

questions.question: Praxys 如何结合运动科学、个体化和 AI？
questions.answer: Praxys 以你的训练数据和已发表的运动科学为起点，通过确定性计算和校验规则建立可靠基础。随后在 AI 最擅长的环节使用它：识别模式、解释取舍、探索研究，并根据你的情况调整计划。资料来源、明确的限制、计划校验和规则回退让结果可追溯、可控，而不是要求你相信一个黑箱。

questions.question: 托管训练计划如何运作？
questions.answer: Praxys 会在未来 14 天的滚动窗口内管理自己生成或由跑者明确接管的训练，不依赖特定交付平台。计划可以根据当前训练与恢复状态进行调整。你可以选择交付到 Garmin 或 Stryd，并随时暂停、恢复、处理冲突或退出托管模式。

questions.question: Praxys 如何使用我的训练数据？
questions.answer: 你的数据仅用于提供训练分析、建议和计划。Praxys 不会出售跑者数据，也不会将其用于广告。Praxys Labs 等研究功能需要另行明确同意。隐私政策会说明数据处理、保留和安全措施。
